name: Shinmon -examination-
source:
The small country of Resaria has been overrun by the empire of Irul. The beautiful knight, Eriru has been taken captive and is subject to unspeakable torture.
She does not know that the princess Firie who she has sworn to protect with her life is receiving an even worse violation.

The trials continue without ceasing...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE041988.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
雷萨里亚小国已被伊鲁尔帝国占领。美丽的骑士埃里鲁（Eriru）被俘虏，并遭受难以言喻的酷刑。
她不知道，她发誓要用生命守护的菲莉公主，正遭受着更严重的侵犯。

试炼仍在继续，没有停止……

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE041988.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
